extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots digitised from Figure 3. Figure 4 was not tabulated into records because its ordinate is an MS signal ratio used for a structure–activity correlation and its abscissae are spectroscopic Cu+ descriptors rather than operating variables; it is not directly a plant-model catalytic performance metric. Figures 5 and 6 are transient/SSITKA spectroscopic diagnostics rather than steady catalytic performance plots, and Figure 7 is DFT, so they were skipped under the rules. CO and CH4 selectivities were not plotted in the main-text performance figures.
